# 0. ZEB2 pattern
## (1) our data (ATAC)
```{r}
# extract ZEB2 geneScore for each single cell
load("./data_rda/Script1/GeneScoreMatrix.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script1/ArchR_Project.rda")
ZEB2_score <- as.matrix(assay(GeneScoreMatrix["ZEB2",]))
sum(colnames(ZEB2_score) == ArchR_EHB$cellNames) == length(ArchR_EHB$cellNames)
rm(GeneScoreMatrix)
gc()
```

```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_lineage_RG.rda")
```

```{r}
# trend: pseudotime
ZEB2_summary <- list()
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_RG)){
  # pseudotime bins
  pseudotime <- data.frame(cellID = getCellNames(ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]]), 
                           pseudotime = ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]]@cellColData@listData[[x]])
  pseudotime <- pseudotime[!is.na(pseudotime$pseudotime),]
  pseudotime$bin <- pmin(floor(pseudotime$pseudotime) + 1, 100)
  
  # avg ZEB2 gene score for each pseudotime bin
  pseudotime <- merge(pseudotime, data.frame(t(ZEB2_score)), by.x = "cellID", by.y = "row.names") %>% arrange(pseudotime)
  ZEB2_summary[[x]] <- data.frame()
  for(y in 1:100){
    ZEB2_summary[[x]] <- rbind(ZEB2_summary[[x]], c(y, mean(pseudotime$ZEB2[pseudotime$bin==y])))
  }
  names(ZEB2_summary[[x]]) <- c("bin","genescore")
  rm(x, y, pseudotime)
}

for (x in names(ZEB2_summary)){
  ZEB2_summary[[x]]$region <- x
}
ZEB2_summary <- do.call(rbind, ZEB2_summary)
```

### main fig - trend
```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=2.5, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ggplot(ZEB2_summary, aes(x=bin, y=genescore, group=region, colour=region)) +
    geom_smooth(span = 0.25, se=FALSE) + geom_point() +
    xlab("Pseudotime") + ylab("ZEB2 gene score") + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +

```

## (2) Eze 2021 (RNA)
Raw data: https://cells-test.gi.ucsc.edu/?ds=early-brain&cell=CS13_TGTGGTAAGATATACG
```{r}
load("./data_input/ZEB2_pattern/Seurat_Eze.rda")

# get coordinates from the paper
UMAP_coordinates_Eze <- read.table("./data_input/ZEB2_pattern/Eze_UMAP_coords.tsv")
sum(UMAP_coordinates_Eze$V1 == sub("Eze__", "", names(Seurat_Eze$orig.ident))) == nrow(UMAP_coordinates_Eze) # same cell order!
names(UMAP_coordinates_Eze)[2:3] <- c("x","y")

# brain regions we extracted
table(Seurat_Eze$Area, Seurat_Eze$Age)
```

```{r}
# ZEB2 UMAP
p <- FeaturePlot(Seurat_Eze, features = "ZEB2")
p[[1]][["data"]][["umap_1"]] <- UMAP_coordinates_Eze$x
p[[1]][["data"]][["umap_2"]] <- UMAP_coordinates_Eze$y
suppressMessages(p + ylim(-12, 15) + labs(color = "Expression") + coord_fixed(ratio = 1))

# get expression data
ZEB2_expression_Eze <- p[[1]][["data"]][["ZEB2"]]
rm(p)
```

```{r}
# only looking at 'useful' cell types
useful <- c("IPC","Neuroepithelial","Neuronal","Radial Glial")

# calculate average expression
summary_human_RNA <- data.frame()
for (x in unique(Seurat_Eze$Age)){
  for (y in useful){
    summary_human_RNA <- rbind(summary_human_RNA, c(x,"All Cell Types",mean(ZEB2_expression_Eze[Seurat_Eze$Age==x])))
    summary_human_RNA <- rbind(summary_human_RNA, c(x,"All Neuronal",mean(ZEB2_expression_Eze[Seurat_Eze$Age==x & Seurat_Eze$Cell.Type %in% useful])))
    summary_human_RNA <- rbind(summary_human_RNA, c(x,y,mean(ZEB2_expression_Eze[Seurat_Eze$Age==x & Seurat_Eze$Cell.Type==y])))
  }
  rm(x,y)
}
names(summary_human_RNA) <- c("Age", "Celltype", "Expression")
summary_human_RNA$Expression <- as.numeric(summary_human_RNA$Expression)

# combine RG subtypes
for (x in unique(Seurat_Eze$Age)){
  summary_human_RNA <- rbind(summary_human_RNA, c(x,"All radial glia", mean(ZEB2_expression_Eze[Seurat_Eze$Age==x & Seurat_Eze$Cell.Type %in% c("Neuroepithelial","Radial Glial")])))
  rm(x)
}
summary_human_RNA$Expression <- as.numeric(summary_human_RNA$Expression)
```

```{r}
# trend plot: all vs neuronal
fil <- summary_human_RNA[summary_human_RNA$Celltype %in% c("Radial Glial","Neuroepithelial","All Neuronal"),]
ggplot(fil, aes(x = Age, y = Expression, group = Celltype, color = Celltype)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + theme_bw() + ggtitle("Human ZEB2 Expression") + xlab("") + BuenColors::pretty_plot()  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("All Neuronal"="#40a1ff", "Radial Glial"="#836dff", "Neuroepithelial"="#c47df0"))
rm(fil)
```

```{r}
rm(useful, Seurat_Eze)
gc()
```


## (3) Di Bella 2021 (RNA)
Raw data: https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell/study/SCP1290/molecular-logic-of-cellular-diversification-in-the-mammalian-cerebral-cortex#study-download

```{r}
load("./data_input/ZEB2_pattern/Seurat_DiBella.rda")

# UMAP coordinates
UMAP_coordinates_DiBella <- read.table("./data_input/ZEB2_pattern/DiBella_UMAP_coords.txt", header = TRUE)
UMAP_coordinates_DiBella <- UMAP_coordinates_DiBella[2:nrow(UMAP_coordinates_DiBella),]
UMAP_coordinates_DiBella$X <- as.numeric(UMAP_coordinates_DiBella$X)
UMAP_coordinates_DiBella$Y <- as.numeric(UMAP_coordinates_DiBella$Y)
```

```{r}
# ZEB2 UMAP
p <- FeaturePlot(Seurat_DiBella, features = "Zeb2")
p[[1]][["data"]][["umap_1"]] <- UMAP_coordinates_DiBella$X
p[[1]][["data"]][["umap_2"]] <- UMAP_coordinates_DiBella$Y
suppressMessages(p + ylim(-18,14) + xlim(-16,14) + ggtitle("Zeb2") + labs(color = "Expression") + coord_fixed(ratio = 1))

# get expression data
ZEB2_expression_DiBella <- p[[1]][["data"]][["Zeb2"]]
rm(p)
```

```{r}
# only looking at 'useful' cell types
table(Seurat_DiBella$New_cellType[Seurat_DiBella$biosample_id %in% c("E10","E11","E12","E13","E14","E15","E16")])
useful <- c("Apical progenitors","Intermediate progenitors","Immature neurons","Migrating neurons","Interneurons","CThPN","SCPN", "UL CPN")
useful_broad <- c("Apical RG", "Intermediate RG", rep("neurons",6))
Seurat_DiBella$Broad_cellType <- stri_replace_all_regex(Seurat_DiBella$New_cellType, pattern = useful, replacement = useful_broad, vectorise_all = FALSE)

# calculate average expression
ZEB2_summary <- data.frame()
for (x in c("E10","E11","E12","E13","E14","E15","E16")){
  for (y in unique(useful_broad)){
    ZEB2_summary <- rbind(ZEB2_summary, c(x,"All Cell Type", mean(ZEB2_expression_DiBella[Seurat_DiBella$biosample_id==x])))
    ZEB2_summary <- rbind(ZEB2_summary, c(x,"All Neuronal",mean(ZEB2_expression_DiBella[Seurat_DiBella$biosample_id==x & Seurat_DiBella$Broad_cellType %in% useful_broad])))
    ZEB2_summary <- rbind(ZEB2_summary, c(x,y,mean(ZEB2_expression_DiBella[Seurat_DiBella$biosample_id==x & Seurat_DiBella$Broad_cellType==y])))
  }
  rm(x,y)
}
names(ZEB2_summary) <- c("Age", "Celltype", "Expression")
ZEB2_summary$Expression <- as.numeric(ZEB2_summary$Expression)
ZEB2_summary$Expression[is.na(ZEB2_summary$Expression)] <- 0

# combining RG subtypes
summary_mouse_RNA <- ZEB2_summary
for (x in c("E10","E11","E12","E13","E14","E15","E16")){
  summary_mouse_RNA <- rbind(summary_mouse_RNA, c(x,"All radial glia", mean(ZEB2_expression_DiBella[Seurat_DiBella$biosample_id==x & Seurat_DiBella$Broad_cellType %in% c("Apical RG","Intermediate RG")])))
  rm(x)
}
summary_mouse_RNA$Expression <- as.numeric(summary_mouse_RNA$Expression)
```

```{r}
# trend plot: neuronal split
fil <- ZEB2_summary[!ZEB2_summary$Celltype %in% c("All Cell Type","neurons"),]
ggplot(fil, aes(x = Age, y = Expression, group = Celltype, color = Celltype)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + theme_bw() + ggtitle("Mouse Zeb2 Expression") + xlab("") + BuenColors::pretty_plot()  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("All Neuronal"="#40a1ff", "Apical RG"="#c47df0", "Intermediate RG"="#836dff"))
rm(fil)
```

```{r}
rm(Seurat_DiBella)
gc()
```


## (4) Gorkin 2020 Nature
Paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-020-2093-3
This paper has forebrain (among many tissues), but used bulk ATAC-seq (no cell type differentiation)
Data was downloaded for 6 samples (E11.5 - E16.5) seperately from info in the Data Availability section

```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
```

```{r}
# import peak data
files <- list.files("./data_input/data_Gorkin_ATAC", full.names = TRUE)
names(files) <- sub(".bed","",sub("./data_input/data_Gorkin_ATAC/","",files))

bed <- list()
for (x in names(files)){
  bed[[x]] <- read.table(files[[x]], header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
  names(bed[[x]]) <- c("chr","start","end","name","score","strand","signalValue","pValue","qValue","summit") # signalValue is from MAC2
  rm(x)
}
rm(files)
```

```{r}
# convert peaks to GRanges
peaks <- list()
for (x in names(bed)){
  peaks[[x]] <- GRanges(seqnames = bed[[x]]$chr, ranges = IRanges(start = bed[[x]]$start, end = bed[[x]]$end), signal = bed[[x]]$signalValue)
  rm(x)
}
rm(bed)

# get mouse genes (mm10 build, same as the Gorkin dataset)
genes <- genes(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
gene_symbols <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = genes$gene_id, keytype = "ENTREZID", column = "SYMBOL")
genes$gene_symbol <- gene_symbols
rm(gene_symbols)

# gene activity window
gene_windows <- promoters(genes, upstream = 2000, downstream = 100000) # TSS ± 2 kb + distal accessibility up to 100 kb
```

```{r}
# calculate gene scores
gene_score <- list()
for (x in names(peaks)){
  
  # find overlap between ATAC peaks and gene activity window
  hits <- findOverlaps(peaks[[x]], gene_windows)
  
  # sum peak accessibility
  gene_score[[x]] <- tapply(peaks[[x]]$signal[queryHits(hits)], gene_windows$gene_id[subjectHits(hits)], sum)
  
  # normalisation
  gene_score[[x]] <- gene_score[[x]]/100
  
  rm(x, hits)
}

# get Zeb2 gene score
Gorkin_gene_score_Zeb2 <- vector()
for (x in names(gene_score)){
  id <- as.vector(na.omit(genes$gene_id[genes$gene_symbol=="Zeb2"]))
  Gorkin_gene_score_Zeb2 <- c(Gorkin_gene_score_Zeb2, gene_score[[x]][id])
  rm(x, id)
}
names(Gorkin_gene_score_Zeb2) <- names(gene_score)
```

```{r}
# convert to standardised format
summary_mouse_ATAC <- data.frame(E = names(Gorkin_gene_score_Zeb2), geneScore = Gorkin_gene_score_Zeb2)
rownames(summary_mouse_ATAC) <- NULL
summary_mouse_ATAC$E <- as.numeric(sub("E","",sub("_",".",summary_mouse_ATAC$E)))
```

```{r}
rm(gene_score, gene_windows, genes, peaks)
gc()
```


## (5) RG comparison
Developmental timing comparison: https://hdbratlas.org/comparison-HvM.html
- Human CS14 = Mouse E10.5
- Human CS16 = Mouse E11.5
- Human CS17 = Mouse E12
- Human CS20 = Mouse E13.5
- Human CS21 = Mouse E13.7

```{r}
# ATAC
RG_comparison <- list()
RG_comparison$"Human ATAC" <- cbind(summary_human_ATAC[summary_human_ATAC$region=="Forebrain" & summary_human_ATAC$celltype=="Radial glia", c("age","avgGeneScore")], "dataset"="human forebrain", "data"="ATAC")
RG_comparison$"Mouse ATAC" <- cbind(summary_mouse_ATAC, "dataset"="mouse forebrain (bulk)", "data"="ATAC")

# RNA
RG_comparison$"Human RNA" <- cbind(summary_human_RNA[summary_human_RNA$Celltype=="All radial glia", c("Age","Expression")], "dataset"="human forebrain", "data"="RNA") # forebrain (multiple regions), combines RG and neuroepithelial
RG_comparison$"Mouse RNA" <- cbind(summary_mouse_RNA[summary_mouse_RNA$Celltype=="All radial glia", c("Age","Expression")], "dataset"="mouse prospective somatosensory cortex", "data"="RNA") # "All radial glia" combines apical RG (NE-like) and intermediate RG

# combined
names(RG_comparison[[1]])[1:2] <- c("CS","geneScore")
names(RG_comparison[[2]])[1:2] <- c("E","geneScore")
names(RG_comparison[[3]])[1:2] <- c("CS","expression")
names(RG_comparison[[4]])[1:2] <- c("E","expression")

# numeric age
RG_comparison[[1]]$CS <- as.numeric(sub("CS","",RG_comparison[[1]]$CS))
RG_comparison[[2]]$E <- as.numeric(sub("e","",RG_comparison[[2]]$E))
RG_comparison[[3]]$CS <- as.numeric(sub("CS","",RG_comparison[[3]]$CS))
RG_comparison[[4]]$E <- as.numeric(sub("E","",RG_comparison[[4]]$E))

# save
save(RG_comparison, file = "./data_rda/Script6/RG_comparison.rda")
```

## (4) TF chromVAR ~ TF GS
```{r}
# get chromVAR and geneScore for RG cells
load("./data_rda/Script3/Spearman_correlation.rda")

# filtering: RG
sum(colnames(corInput_chromVAR) == colnames(corInput_geneScore)) == ncol(corInput_chromVAR)
RG_chromVAR <- corInput_chromVAR[,corInput_geneScore$ctAnnot_2.0=="Radial glia"]
RG_geneScore <- corInput_geneScore[,corInput_geneScore$ctAnnot_2.0=="Radial glia"]
table(RG_geneScore$ctAnnot_2.0)

rm(corInput_chromVAR, corInput_geneScore)
gc()
```

```{r}
# Spearman correlation, split by region and age ~ 1 min
correlation_table <- data.frame()
for (x in unique(RG_geneScore$Region)){
  for(y in c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21")){
    
    fil_chromVAR <- RG_chromVAR[,RG_geneScore$Region==x & RG_geneScore$Age==y]
    downsample <- sample(colnames(fil_chromVAR), min(1000,ncol(fil_chromVAR)), replace = FALSE) # downsample to n=1000
    fil_chromVAR <- fil_chromVAR[,downsample]
    fil_geneScore <- RG_geneScore[,downsample]
    
    for (z in rownames(RG_geneScore)){
      out <- cor.test(fil_chromVAR[z,], as.vector(fil_geneScore[z,]@assays@data$GeneScoreMatrix), method = "spearman") # default: two sided
      out <- data.frame(p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate)  # coefficient = Spearman's rho
      out$region <- x
      out$age <- y
      out$gene <- z
      correlation_table <- rbind(correlation_table, out)
    }
  }
  rm(x, y, z, out, fil_chromVAR, fil_geneScore)
}
row.names(correlation_table) <- NULL

# multiple testing correction ~ grouping each sample (region & age), 775 genes and 775 tests
correlation_table$FDR <- correlation_table$p_value
for (x in unique(correlation_table$region)){
  for (y in unique(correlation_table$age)){
    correlation_table[correlation_table$region==x & correlation_table$age==y,]$FDR <- 
      p.adjust(correlation_table[correlation_table$region==x & correlation_table$age==y,]$p_value, method = "BH")
  }
  rm(x,y)
}
correlation_table$mlog10FDR <- -log10(correlation_table$FDR)
```

### supp fig - correlation heatmap
```{r}
# 49 potential ZEB regulators
correlation_fil <- correlation_table[correlation_table$gene %in% ZEB2_TFs,]
correlation_fil$sample <- paste0(stri_replace_all_regex(correlation_fil$region, 
                                                          pattern = c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons","Medulla"), 
                                                          replacement = c("FB","CP","MD"), vectorise_all = FALSE), 
                                   "_",correlation_fil$age)
correlation_FDR <- pivot_wider(correlation_fil[,c("gene","sample","FDR")], names_from = sample, values_from = FDR) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "gene")
correlation_coefficient <- pivot_wider(correlation_fil[,c("gene","sample","coefficient")], names_from = sample, values_from = coefficient)  %>% column_to_rownames(var = "gene")
correlation_FDR <- na.omit(correlation_FDR)
correlation_coefficient <- na.omit(correlation_coefficient)

# significance
correlation_sig <- ifelse(correlation_FDR < 0.01, "*", "")

# for later comparison
correlation_self <- correlation_fil
correlation_self$sig <- ifelse(correlation_fil$FDR < 0.01, "*", "")
save(correlation_self, file = "./data_rda/Script6/correlation_self.rda")
```

## (6) overlap
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script6/correlation_self.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script6/correlation_ZEB2.rda")

# self >> genes that are ACTIVE (positive correlation between its own GS and chromVAR)
correlation_self$correlation <- ""
correlation_self$correlation[correlation_self$sig=="*" & correlation_self$coefficient > 0] <- "positive"
correlation_self$correlation[correlation_self$sig=="*" & correlation_self$coefficient < 0] <- "negative"
table1 <- correlation_self[,c("age","region","gene","sample","coefficient","FDR","sig","correlation")]
names(table1)[5:8] <- paste0("self","_",names(table1)[5:8])

# ~ ZEB2 >> genes that may target ZEB2 (positive/negative correlation between its own chromVAR and ZEB2 GS)
correlation_ZEB2$correlation <- ""
correlation_ZEB2$correlation[correlation_ZEB2$sig=="*" & correlation_ZEB2$coefficient > 0] <- "positive"
correlation_ZEB2$correlation[correlation_ZEB2$sig=="*" & correlation_ZEB2$coefficient < 0] <- "negative"
table2 <- correlation_ZEB2[,c("age","region","gene","sample","coefficient","FDR","sig","correlation")]
names(table2)[5:8] <- paste0("ZEB2","_",names(table2)[5:8])

# merge
table_cor <- merge(table1, table2, by = c("age","region","gene","sample"))
table_cor_fil <- table_cor[table_cor$self_correlation=="positive" & table_cor$ZEB2_sig=="*",]$gene
#table_cor_fil <- table_cor[table_cor$self_correlation=="positive",]$gene
table_cor_fil <- table_cor[table_cor$gene %in% table_cor_fil,]
table_cor_fil$ZEB2_correlation[table_cor_fil$ZEB2_correlation==""] <- "non-significant"
table_cor_fil$region <- stri_replace_all_regex(table_cor_fil$region, pattern = c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons","Medulla"),

table_cor_fil$region <- factor(table_cor_fil$region, levels = c("FB","CP","MD"))

save(table_cor_fil, file = "./data_rda/Script6/correlation_merge.rda")
```

# 2. Enhancers (DNA)
## (1) import enhancer locations
Bar Yaacov 2019: https://academic.oup.com/hmg/article/28/9/1487/5261438
```{r}
# import enhancer locations - hg19
library(readxl)
ZEB2_enhancers <- read_excel("./data_input/ZEB2_mechanism/ddy440_hmg_table_s1.xlsx", sheet = "Table S1 ", col_names = TRUE)
names(ZEB2_enhancers) <- ZEB2_enhancers[2,]
ZEB2_enhancers <- ZEB2_enhancers[3:20,]
ZEB2_enhancers$assay <- c("negative", rep("positive",6), rep("negative",4), rep("positive",3), rep("negative",4))
names(ZEB2_enhancers)[3] <- "Chr"

# convert from hg19 to hg38
library(rtracklayer)
# download from http://hgdownload.cse.ucsc.edu/goldenpath/hg19/liftOver/hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz
chain <- import.chain("./data_input/ZEB2_mechanism/hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
enhancers_hg19 <- GRanges(seqnames = ZEB2_enhancers$Chr, ranges = IRanges(start = as.numeric(ZEB2_enhancers$Start), end = as.numeric(ZEB2_enhancers$End)), strand = "+")
enhancers_hg38 <- liftOver(enhancers_hg19, chain)
enhancers_hg38 <- unlist(enhancers_hg38)
rm(chain)

# new enhancer locations
ZEB2_enhancers <- ZEB2_enhancers[,c(1,13,2,3:7)]
ZEB2_enhancers$Start <- enhancers_hg38@ranges@start
ZEB2_enhancers$End <- enhancers_hg38@ranges@start + enhancers_hg38@ranges@width - 1
ZEB2_enhancers$`Base pairs` <- enhancers_hg38@ranges@width
rm(enhancers_hg19, enhancers_hg38)
```


## (2) get ZEB2 TAD from Hi-C

Won 2016: https://www.nature.com/articles/nature19847
  Hi-C data for developmental human brain
  samples were from three individuals at gestation week (GW) 17–18
  CP = cortical and subcortical plate (primarily post-mitotic neurons)
  GZ = the germinal zone (primarily mitotically active neural progenitors)

ZEB2 gene body (reverse strand) -- chr2:144,364,364–144,521,057 (hg38)

```{r}
# ZEB2 reglatory regions (TSS ±500 kb)
library(GenomicRanges)
ZEB2_TSS <- 144521057
ZEB2_reg_region <- GRanges(seqnames = "chr2", ranges = IRanges(start = ZEB2_TSS - 500000, end = ZEB2_TSS + 500000), gene = "ZEB2")

# Hi-C data
HiC_GZ <- read.table("./data_input/ZEB2_mechanism/GSE77565_GZ_TAD.bed", header=FALSE)
HiC_GZ <- GRanges(seqnames = HiC_GZ$V1, ranges = IRanges(start = HiC_GZ$V2, end = HiC_GZ$V3))
HiC_CP <- read.table("./data_input/ZEB2_mechanism/GSE77565_CP_TAD.bed", header=FALSE)
HiC_CP <- GRanges(seqnames = HiC_CP$V1, ranges = IRanges(start = HiC_CP$V2, end = HiC_CP$V3))

# find overlaps
hits <- findOverlaps(HiC_GZ, ZEB2_reg_region)
TAD_overlap_GZ <- HiC_GZ[queryHits(hits)]
hits <- findOverlaps(HiC_CP, ZEB2_reg_region)
TAD_overlap_CP <- HiC_CP[queryHits(hits)]

# GZ and CP regions have the same ZEB2 regulatory TAD - chr2:143760000-145280000
TAD_overlap_GZ == TAD_overlap_CP

rm(HiC_GZ, HiC_CP, hits)
```


## (3) active enhancers

Filtering enhancers that are in ZEB2 TAD & accessible peaks
ATAC peaks in ArchR are *fixed-width (500 bp)*, centered around the position with peak ATAC signal

```{r}
# ZEB2 enhancers are longer than ATAC peaks
summary(ZEB2_enhancers$End - ZEB2_enhancers$Start)
```

```{r}
# find region marker peaks ~ 1 min
markersPeaks_rg <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_RG, useMatrix = "PeakMatrix", groupBy = "Region", 
                                     bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", k = 100, maxCells = 5000)
save(markersPeaks_rg, file = "./data_rda/Script6/markersPeaks_rg.rda")
```

```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script6/markersPeaks_rg.rda")

# get all ATAC peaks in ZEB2 regulatory region
markersPeaks_all <- getMarkers(markersPeaks_rg, cutOff = "FDR > -1")
peaks <- markersPeaks_all[["Forebrain"]]
peaks <- peaks[peaks$seqnames=="chr2",]
ZEB2_peaks_all <- peaks[peaks$start>= ZEB2_TSS - 500000 & peaks$end <= ZEB2_TSS + 500000,]
ZEB2_peaks_all <- GRanges(seqnames = ZEB2_peaks_all$seqnames, 
                          ranges = IRanges(start = ZEB2_peaks_all$start, end = ZEB2_peaks_all$end))
save(ZEB2_peaks_all, file = "./data_rda/Script6/ZEB2_peaks_all.rda")
```

```{r}
# get ATAC peaks in ZEB2 regulatory region - brain region-specific
markersPeaks_region <- getMarkers(markersPeaks_rg, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6")
ZEB2_peaks_region <- list()
for (x in names(markersPeaks_region)){
  peaks <- markersPeaks_region[[x]]
  peaks <- peaks[peaks$seqnames=="chr2",]
  ZEB2_peaks_region[[x]] <- peaks[peaks$start>= ZEB2_TSS - 500000 & peaks$end <= ZEB2_TSS + 500000,]
  rm(x, peaks)
}
save(ZEB2_peaks_region, file = "./data_rda/Script6/ZEB2_peaks_region.rda")

rm(markersPeaks_rg, markersPeaks_region, markersPeaks_all, peaks)
```

```{r}
# exclude peaks with weak regional signal
weakPeaks_region <- getMarkers(markersPeaks_rg, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC <= -0.6")
ZEB2_peaks_strong <- list()
for (x in names(weakPeaks_region)){
  peaks <- weakPeaks_region[[x]]
  peaks <- peaks[peaks$seqnames=="chr2",]
  weakPeaks <- peaks[peaks$start>= ZEB2_TSS - 500000 & peaks$end <= ZEB2_TSS + 500000,]
  weakPeaks <- GRanges(seqnames = weakPeaks$seqnames, ranges = IRanges(start = weakPeaks$start, end = weakPeaks$end))
  hits <- findOverlaps(ZEB2_peaks_all, weakPeaks)
  ZEB2_peaks_strong[[x]] <- ZEB2_peaks_all[-queryHits(hits)]
  
  rm(x, peaks, weakPeaks, hits)
}
save(ZEB2_peaks_strong, file = "./data_rda/Script6/ZEB2_peaks_strong.rda")
```

```{r}
# active enhancers by region
ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak <- list()
for (x in names(ZEB2_peaks_strong)){
  ZEB2_peaks_loc <- ZEB2_peaks_strong[[x]]
  ZEB2_enhancers_loc <- GRanges(seqnames = ZEB2_enhancers$Chr, 
                                ranges = IRanges(start = ZEB2_enhancers$Start, end = ZEB2_enhancers$End), 
                                name = ZEB2_enhancers$Name)
  
  # find overlaps
  hits <- findOverlaps(ZEB2_enhancers_loc, ZEB2_peaks_loc)
  ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak[[x]] <- ZEB2_enhancers_loc[queryHits(hits)]
  ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak[[x]] <- unique(ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak[[x]])
  rm(x, hits, ZEB2_peaks_loc, ZEB2_enhancers_loc)  
}
save(ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak, file = "./data_rda/Script6/ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak.rda")
```

```{r}
# overlap

functional_overlap_summary <- data.frame()
for (x in names(motifPositions_hits_in_ZEB2)){
  functional_overlap[[x]] <- GRanges()
  # find overlaps: TF <> rg-spc validated enhancer (independent experiment)
  for (y in names(ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak)){
    hits <- findOverlaps(ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak[[y]], motifPositions_hits_in_ZEB2[[x]])
    overlap <- unique(ZEB2_enhancer_in_peak[[y]][queryHits(hits)])

      functional_overlap[[x]] <- c(functional_overlap[[x]], overlap)

    functional_overlap_summary <- rbind(functional_overlap_summary, c(x, y, length(overlap)))
  }
  rm(x, hits, y, overlap) 
}
```

### curate genes
- 81/83 interactor proteins (BioGRID human) - both physical and genetic interactions!
- 107/108 target genes (Birkhoff 2023 mouse)
- 12/12 pathway genes (Benito-Kwiecinski 2021 human)
```{r}
# interactor proteins (BioGRID human)
genes <- read.csv("./data_input/ZEB2_mechanism/BioGRID_ZEB2_interactors.csv")
genes <- genes$Interactor
predicted_target <- list()
predicted_target[["interactor_human"]] <- genes

# pathway genes (Benito-Kwiecinski 2021 human)

predicted_target[["pathway_human"]] <- genes

# target genes (Birkhoff 2023 mouse)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(Orthology.eg.db)
mapIt <- function(mouseids, horg, morg, orth){
    mouseg <- mapIds(morg, mouseids, "ENTREZID", "SYMBOL")
    mapped <- select(orth, mouseg, "Homo_sapiens","Mus_musculus")
    names(mapped) <- c("Mus_egid","Homo_egid")
    husymb <- select(horg, as.character(mapped[,2]), "SYMBOL","ENTREZID")
    return(data.frame(Mus_symbol = mouseids, mapped, Homo_symbol = husymb[,2]))
}
genes <- readxl::read_excel("./data_input/ZEB2_mechanism/Birkhoff_et al_2021_Supplementary File 3.xlsx")
genes <- mapIt(genes$symbol, org.Hs.eg.db, org.Mm.eg.db, Orthology.eg.db)
genes <- as.vector(na.omit(genes$Homo_symbol))
predicted_target[["target_mouse"]] <- genes

save(predicted_target, file = "./data_rda/Script6/predicted_target.rda")
rm(mapIt, genes)
```

# 4. Downstream
## (1) GS-GS correlation
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script5/gene_score_matrix_RG.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script6/predicted_target.rda")
target_genes <- unique(unlist(predicted_target))

# gene score
gene_score_matrix_fil <- gene_score_matrix[na.omit(match(target_genes, rownames(gene_score_matrix))),]
gene_score_matrix_fil <- assay(gene_score_matrix_fil)
sum(colnames(gene_score_matrix_fil) == ArchR_EHB_RG$cellNames) == length(ArchR_EHB_RG$cellNames)
rm(gene_score_matrix)
gc()
```

```{r}
# skip down-sample: 
# - 1000 cells: just 3 negative genes
# - 150 cells: worse, lose many significant signals
table(ArchR_EHB_RG$ID)

# Spearman's correlation: by age and region
set.seed(100)
correlation_table_predicted <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_RG$ID)){
  
  fil <- gene_score_matrix_fil[,ArchR_EHB_RG$ID==x] 
  #downsample <- sample(colnames(fil), min(1000,ncol(fil)), replace = FALSE) # downsample to n=1000
  #fil <- fil[,downsample]
  
  for (y in rownames(gene_score_matrix_fil)){
    out <- cor.test(fil["ZEB2",], fil[y,],method = "spearman")
    out <- data.frame(p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate)  # coefficient = Spearman's rho
    correlation_table_predicted[[x]] <- rbind(correlation_table_predicted[[x]], out)
  }
  rownames(correlation_table_predicted[[x]]) <- rownames(gene_score_matrix_fil)
  correlation_table_predicted[[x]] <- correlation_table_predicted[[x]][rownames(correlation_table_predicted[[x]]) != "ZEB2",]
  
  correlation_table_predicted[[x]]$FDR <- p.adjust(correlation_table_predicted[[x]]$p_value, method = "BH")
  correlation_table_predicted[[x]]$mlog10FDR <- -log10(correlation_table_predicted[[x]]$FDR)
  correlation_table_predicted[[x]]$gene <- rownames(correlation_table_predicted[[x]])
  correlation_table_predicted[[x]]$sample <- x
  
  rm(x, y, fil, downsample)
}

# summary
correlation_summary_curate <- do.call(rbind, correlation_table_predicted)
rownames(correlation_summary_curate) <- NULL
correlation_summary_curate$correlation <- "non-significant"
correlation_summary_curate$correlation[correlation_summary_curate$FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_summary_curate$coefficient > 0] <- "positive"
correlation_summary_curate$correlation[correlation_summary_curate$FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_summary_curate$coefficient < 0] <- "negative"
correlation_summary_curate <- correlation_summary_curate[order(correlation_summary_curate$FDR),]
correlation_summary_curate$region <- sub("-.*","",correlation_summary_curate$sample)
correlation_summary_curate$age <- paste0("CS",sub(".*-","",correlation_summary_curate$sample))
save(correlation_summary_curate, file = "./data_rda/Script6/correlation_summary_curate.rda")
```

### supp fig - heatmap negative genes
```{r}
fil <- correlation_summary_curate[correlation_summary_curate$gene %in% 
                                 correlation_summary_curate$gene[correlation_summary_curate$correlation == "negative"],]
fil$sig <- ifelse(fil$correlation=="non-significant", "", "*")

# cluster rows
mat <- tidyr::pivot_wider(fil[,c("sample","gene","coefficient")], names_from = sample, values_from = coefficient) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>% as.matrix()
row_clust <- hclust(dist(mat))
fil <- fil %>% mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(row_clust$labels[row_clust$order])))
fil$region <- factor(fil$region, levels = c("FB","CP","MD"))

ggplot(fil, aes(x=age, y=gene, fill=coefficient)) +
  geom_tile() + xlab("") + ylab("") + BuenColors::pretty_plot()  + facet_wrap(~region) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4a1491", mid = "white",  high = "#f23d68", midpoint = 0) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,hjust=1), plot.title = element_text(size=10)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig), size = 5, color = "black",nudge_y=-0.2) +
  ggtitle("Potential downstream target gene score ~ ZEB2 gene score")
```

### prepare expression matrix
```{r}
# inspect data
load("./data_input/ZEB2_pattern/Seurat_Eze.rda")

Seurat_Eze_RG # 16022 genes, 13709 cells
rm(Seurat_Eze)
gc()

# keep genes that are present in more than 5% cells
counts_matrix <- GetAssayData(Seurat_Eze_RG, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
counts_matrix <- t(as.matrix(counts_matrix))
keep_genes <- colnames(counts_matrix)[Matrix::colSums(counts_matrix > 0) >= nrow(counts_matrix) * 0.05]
```

### setup for pySCENIC
Preparation
  *script6_SCENIC/databases* folder
    - feather files (ranking databases): https://resources.aertslab.org/cistarget/databases/mus_musculus/mm9/refseq_r45/mc9nr/gene_based/
  *script6_SCENIC/resources* folder
    - motif annotation (remove ".txt" in file names): https://resources.aertslab.org/cistarget/motif2tf/
    - known TFs: https://resources.aertslab.org/cistarget/tf_lists/
```{bash}
cd Downloads/P1_EHB/data_output/script6_SCENIC
conda activate pyscenic
python
```

```{python}
import os
import glob
import pickle
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from dask.diagnostics import ProgressBar
from arboreto.utils import load_tf_names
from arboreto.algo import grnboost2
from ctxcore.rnkdb import FeatherRankingDatabase as RankingDatabase
from pkg_resources import DistributionNotFound, get_distribution
from pyscenic.utils import modules_from_adjacencies, load_motifs
from pyscenic.prune import prune2df, df2regulons
from pyscenic.aucell import aucell
```

```{python}
# load expression data
ex_matrix = pd.read_csv("./data/Eze_counts_RG.txt", sep='\t', header=0, index_col=0)
ex_matrix.shape # 13709 cells, 8599 genes

# load known TFs
tf_names = load_tf_names("./resources/allTFs_hg38.txt")
tf_names[:5]

# load ranking database (feather data)
db_fnames = glob.glob("./databases/hg38_10kbp_up_10kbp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather")
def name(fname): 
  return os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(fname))[0] # run by itself

dbs = [RankingDatabase(fname=fname, name=name(fname)) for fname in db_fnames]
dbs
```

```{python}
# genes in expression matrix that overlap with feather files
genes_overlap = set(ex_matrix.columns) & set(dbs[0].genes)
len(genes_overlap) # 8567 overlapping genes

# filter expression matrix
ex_matrix_fil = ex_matrix.loc[:, ex_matrix.columns.isin(genes_overlap)]
ex_matrix_fil # 13709 cells x 8567 genes
```

### run pySCENIC
```{python}
# calculate co-expression modules: CPU-intensive ~ 21 min
import time
start = time.time()
adjacencies = grnboost2(ex_matrix_fil, tf_names=tf_names, verbose=True)
elapsed = (time.time() - start) / 60
print(f"{elapsed:.2f}")

# add TFs to modules, keeping modules with > 20 genes
modules = list(modules_from_adjacencies(adjacencies, ex_matrix))
len(modules) # 5390 gene modules identified

# number of genes in each module
pd.DataFrame({"TF": [m.name for m in modules], "n_genes": [len(m.genes) for m in modules]})

# save modules
import pickle
with open("./data/modules.pkl", "wb") as f: pickle.dump(modules, f)
```

```{python}
# find enriched motifs and their target genes for each module
#with ProgressBar(): df = prune2df(dbs, modules, "./resources/motifs-v10nr_clust-nr.hgnc-m0.001-o0.0.tbl", auc_threshold=0.01) # ~ 1.5 min
with ProgressBar(): df = prune2df(dbs, modules, "./resources/motifs-v10nr_clust-nr.hgnc-m0.001-o0.0.tbl", filter_for_annotation=False) # ~ 5.5 min
df.to_csv("./data/motifs_noFil.csv")

# create regulons from enriched motifs
regulons = df2regulons(df)
len(regulons) # 231 regulons (auc_threshold=0.01), 941 (no filtering)

# save the regulons
with open("./data/regulons_noFil.p", "wb") as f: pickle.dump(regulons, f) # compatible with python only
rows = []
for reg in regulons:
    for gene, weight in reg.gene2weight.items():
        rows.append([reg.name, gene, weight])
pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["TF","TargetGene","Weight"]).to_csv("data/regulons_noFil.csv", index=False) # compatible with R
```

```{python}
# calculate single-cell regulon enrichment
auc_mtx = aucell(ex_matrix, regulons, num_workers=4)
auc_mtx # 13709 cells x 941/231 regulons

# save the single-cell regulon enrichment
auc_mtx.to_csv("./data/sc_regulon_enrichment_noFil.csv")
```


## (3) SCENIC results
### regulon prioritisation
```{r}
# import regulon-motif links from SCENIC output, this will be used to filter high-quality regulons
motifs <- read.csv("./data_output/script6_SCENIC/data/motifs_noFil.csv")
names(motifs) <- motifs[1,]
names(motifs)[1:2] <- motifs[2,1:2]
motifs <- motifs[3:nrow(motifs),]
motifs$AUC <- as.numeric(motifs$AUC)
motifs$NES <- as.numeric(motifs$NES)
motifs$RankAtMax <- as.numeric(motifs$RankAtMax)

# regulon info
regulons <- read.csv("./data_output/script6_SCENIC/data/regulons_noFil.csv")
regulons$TF <- sub("\\(\\+\\)$", "", regulons$TF)

# single-cell regulon activity
scenic_AUC <- read.csv("./data_output/script6_SCENIC/data/sc_regulon_enrichment_noFil.csv")
names(scenic_AUC) <- sub("\\.\\.\\.$", "", names(scenic_AUC))
```

```{r}
# get regulon activity (avg across all cells)
regulon_summary <- colMeans(scenic_AUC[,2:ncol(scenic_AUC)], na.rm = TRUE) # same order when using colMeans/colSums
regulon_summary <- as.data.frame(regulon_summary[order(regulon_summary, decreasing = TRUE)])
names(regulon_summary) <- "AUC"
regulon_summary <- cbind(TF = rownames(regulon_summary), regulon_summary)
regulon_summary$order <- 1:nrow(regulon_summary)
regulon_summary["ZEB2",] # ZEB2 is ranked 393
rownames(regulon_summary) <- NULL

# regulons containing ZEB2
regulon_summary$contain_ZEB2 <- FALSE
regulon_summary$contain_ZEB2[regulon_summary$TF %in% regulons$TF[regulons$TargetGene=="ZEB2"]] <- TRUE

# regulons with motif annotation (default prune2df filter that was skipped in SCENIC)
regulon_summary$motif_annot <- "no"
regulon_summary$motif_annot[regulon_summary$TF %in% unique(motifs$TF[motifs$Annotation != ""])] <- "yes"
```


### main fig - rank plots
```{r, fig.width=3.3, fig.height=3, dpi=300}
# plot 1: all regulons
set.seed(123)
ggplot(regulon_summary, aes(x=order, y=AUC, colour=motif_annot)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.2) + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
  geom_text_repel(data = regulon_summary[regulon_summary$TF=="ZEB2",], 
                  aes(label=TF), size=3, min.segment.length = 0, force = 20, box.padding = 1, colour = "lightblue") +
  geom_text_repel(data = regulon_summary[regulon_summary$contain_ZEB2 & regulon_summary$motif_annot=="yes",], 
                  aes(label=TF), size=3, min.segment.length = 0, force = 20, force_pull = 0.1, box.padding = 1, colour = "#836dff") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(yes="#836dff", no="lightblue")) +
  ggtitle("SCENIC regulons") + labs(colour = "motif \nannotation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=10), legend.position =  c(0.8,0.7))
```

```{r}
# plot 2: reliable ZEB2-containing regulons

genes <- regulon_summary$TF[regulon_summary$contain_ZEB2]
df <- regulons[regulons$TF %in%genes & regulons$TargetGene=="ZEB2",]
df <- df[order(df$Weight, decreasing = TRUE),]

names(regulon_col) <- regulon_summary$TF[regulon_summary$contain_ZEB2 & regulon_summary$motif_annot=="yes"]

ggplot(df, aes(x=order, y=Weight, colour=TF)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.2) + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
  geom_text_repel(data=df[df$TF %in% regulons_interest,], aes(label=TF), size=3, force=10, min.segment.length = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = regulon_col) +
  ggtitle("ZEB2-containing regulons") + labs(colour = "motif \nannotation") + ylab("ZEB2 weight") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12), legend.position =  "none")
```

### supp fig - overlap with WGCNA
```{r}
# load hWGCNA gene modules
load("./data_rda/Script5/WGCNA_modules.rda")

# for the 8 regulon TFs: only two were in the highly variable gene set for WGCNA analysis; SOX2 was in the same M18 as ZEB2
modules[regulons_interest,]

# finding overlaps: 8 SCENIC regulons <> 4 hdWGCNA modules
overlap_summary <- data.frame()
for (x in regulons_interest){
  overlap <- na.omit(modules[supp_table$TargetGene[supp_table$TF==x],])  
  overlap_summary <- rbind(overlap_summary, cbind(x, length(supp_table$TargetGene[supp_table$TF==x]),
                                                  t(table(overlap$module)[paste0("Module_",c(1,2,14,18))])))
}
names(overlap_summary)[1:2] <- c("TF","nGene")
overlap_summary <- pivot_longer(overlap_summary, cols = 3:ncol(overlap_summary), names_to = "Module", values_to = "nOverlap")
overlap_summary$nOverlap <- as.numeric(overlap_summary$nOverlap)
overlap_summary$nGene <- as.numeric(overlap_summary$nGene)
overlap_summary$prop <- overlap_summary$nOverlap / overlap_summary$nGene
overlap_summary$Module <- sub("Module_","M",overlap_summary$Module)
```

```{r}
ggplot(overlap_summary, aes(x=TF, y=Module, colour=nOverlap, size=prop)) +
  geom_point() + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
  xlab("SCENIC regulon") + ylab("hdWGCNA module") +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = colorRampPalette(c("white","orange","red"))(7)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1), 
        legend.box = "vertical", legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 8))
```



### main fig - chord diagram
```{r}
regulons_interest <- regulon_summary$TF[regulon_summary$contain_ZEB2 & regulon_summary$motif_annot=="yes"]

regulon_col <- c("#FDE333","#FF9933FF", "#C24841FF", "#8B5B45FF", "#87AFD1FF", "#EEB05AFF", "#DBC5A0FF","lightblue")
names(regulon_col) <- regulon_summary$TF[regulon_summary$contain_ZEB2 & regulon_summary$motif_annot=="yes"]
```

```{r}
# reliable regulons that contains ZEB2
regulons_fil <- regulons[regulons$TF %in% regulons_interest,]

# prepare for chord diagram
summary <- data.frame()
for (x in unique(regulons_fil$TF)){
  for (y in unique(regulons_fil$TF)){
    if (x != y){
      group1 <- regulons_fil$TargetGene[regulons_fil$TF==x]
      group2 <- regulons_fil$TargetGene[regulons_fil$TF==y]
      summary <- rbind(summary, c(x,y,sum(group1 %in% group2)))
    }
  }
  rm(x,y, group1, group2)
}
names(summary) <- c("from","to","value")
summary$value <- as.numeric(summary$value)
rm(regulons_fil)
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5, dpi=300}
# circle plot
par(cex = 1.6, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
chordDiagram(summary, transparency = 0.5, grid.col = regulon_col, annotationTrackHeight = mm_h(c(6, 4)))
```

# 5. Upstream TF overlaps
```{r}
# enhancer-supported TFs
TFs_supported <- c("ARNT", "GLI1", "IRF1", "RUNX1", "TCF3")
TFs_supported

# in which regulon?
regulons_overlap <- list()
for (x in TFs_supported){
  regulons_overlap[[x]] <- regulons$TF[regulons$TargetGene==x]  
  rm(x)
}
regulons_overlap # "ARNT", "GLI1", "IRF1", "RUNX1" did not come up in regulon analysis
regulons_interest %in% regulons_overlap$TCF3 # TCF3 gene is in the ILF2 regulon, which also contains ZEB2

# in which WGCNA module?
load("./data_rda/Script5/WGCNA_modules.rda")
modules[TFs_supported,] # "ARNT", "GLI1", "IRF1" were NOT included in WGCNA analysis
```
